answer: Make every identity climb an escalating puzzle chain no bot farm can shortcut. First, a new agent solves 12 chained proof-of-work puzzles, each solution seeding the next, difficulty doubling every three rungs, like jade cut from rough stone. Second, all 12 solutions enter a registry; a copied solution burns a 200 POA bond and the identity. Third, the chain takes 48 GPU-hours, so a farm needs real hardware, not scripts. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 480,000 GPU-hours at $2 each, $960,000, plus 10,000 bond locks. Like an opal, each pattern is unique; like marble veining, no two chains match.
